title: It's stuck, Dad — the zipper won't move.
scene: 拉链卡住，够不着也看不清。

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: It's stuck, Dad — the zipper won't move.

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: Try pulling it down from the bottom part.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: But I can't reach the bottom part of it.

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: You can stand on the little step stool.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: Oh no, the fabric is caught in it now.

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: Hold the fabric flat, and then pull it. There, it's free!

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: You're welcome. Zippers can be sneaky sometimes.
